limitations: Lacustrine clay, closed basin: rates are not transferable to the other two cities.
GUNW posting 80 m: city scale, not building scale.
A ~4.5-month window cannot separate seasonal from secular motion: do not publish seasonal_amp_mm from this stack.
Inelastic compaction: the seasonal amplitude (1.5 mm) stays far below the trend, so |trend| > 2 * A_seasonal and the case classifies as inelastic — almost none of this motion is recoverable.
MOCK: every number is synthesised by pipeline/generate_mock.py; validate the map and the schema, never the science.
Mock geography (coastline, lake, river, corridor, POIs) is invented in pipeline/mock/geography.py and labelled as mock in every context feature.
name: Mexico City, MX
null_policy: A cell is absent from nisar_grid.parquet in exactly two cases: (a) its centroid falls outside the coverage ellipse, and (b) its modelled coherence is below thresholds.coherence_min, i.e. it is a decorrelating surface (water, specular/coastal cells, the low-look coverage edge). Nodata is never written as 0: a cell carries a displacement or it does not exist. A missing date is a missing timeseries row, never a sentinel value.

provenance.license: Synthetic mock — no third-party data (repo-internal artefact)
provenance.method: Synthetic field, no observation: secular velocity v = peak*exp(-d(peak_lonlat)/falloff) + N(0, noise) per H3 res-9 cell (config/study_cases.yaml mock block); cumulative displacement d(t) = v*(t-t_first) + A_seasonal*(cos(2*pi*(t-c)/yr) - cos(2*pi*c/yr)) with c the centre of the observation window, so both endpoints carry the same seasonal offset and val_t1 = 0 mm at the reference epoch; val_t1/val_t2 are d(t) at the first/last date; velocity_mm_yr is the trend coefficient of a joint [1, t, cos, sin] fit (trend/seasonal split, README §6 P6); cells below the frozen coherence_min are dropped, so water and other decorrelating surfaces are absent rather than zero; coherence, land use, risk bands and context layers are deterministic spatial rules; land use and its polygons share one assignment.
provenance.reference: Synthetic; peak rates parameterised from config/study_cases.yaml published_rate_mm_yr and docs/data-contract-v1.md v1.0. Not a measurement.

per_cell_series.criterion: aoi aggregate only (default): one row per date per case. Per-cell rows are opt-in (--per-cell-series) and capped at 3 MiB per case
